description: Life is wonderfully created for you #readjusting #dreamlife #trusttheprocess
transcript: Why wouldn't life work out for me? I work hard, but I work hard mentally. I work hard to be the best version of me physically, spiritually, mentally. I live in this present moment, so why would I not reap the benefits of all the gifts that belong to me in this season? I am always willing to challenge myself. I am not willing to suffer, but I will challenge myself. And I always know when it's time to readjust, when to remove, and when to pivot.
